about: Round 50: the shake’s curve, the band lighting, variations of nine new light themes, strands, stars.

drafts.name: Hits: the shake, earlier and higher
drafts.line: You asked for a shake that starts a little earlier and reaches about 28 px at 0.85 instead of 24, shaped like the boost or the split. Three ways; the curves are on the Hit curves page. The split is now a fifth stronger everywhere. Watch it play.

Circus Minimus, its strongest hit, 51 s

variants.label: To 28 px
variants.note: Starts at 0.6 as today; only the height changes.

variants.label: From 0.55, as the boost
variants.note: The same S-shape as the colour boost, starting at 0.55, 28 px at 0.85.

variants.label: From 0.5, as the split
variants.note: A slow start at 0.5 that keeps steepening, 28 px at 0.85.

drafts.name: The band lights: from which strength
drafts.line: You liked the band lighting on hits above a strength. Last time the threshold was 0.6. Here three thresholds. Watch it play, on several songs.

drafts.name: Strands: the weight
drafts.line: You want “either the thinnest or something in between”. On two themes: the thinnest, then a fifth heavier. Watch it play.

drafts.name: Strands on other themes
drafts.line: The strands, a fifth heavier than the thinnest, on six themes. Four you liked as an idea when the strands were thick; two are new. Pick the themes where it works; “none” is an answer too.

variants.label: Black Iris, its own colours
variants.note: Silver strands, the front one red, instead of navy and lavender.

drafts.name: Stars: the moon’s colour or the line’s
drafts.line: You were not sure the stars should be in a colour. On three themes with a coloured moon: the stars in the moon’s colour, then in the line’s cream.
